company.name: Optimal Dynamics
company.shortDescription: Optimal Dynamics is a SaaS company that uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to disrupt the logistics industry.
company.description: Optimal Dynamics was created from decades of research at Princeton University focused specifically on freight and logistics. We believe continual learning and challenging ourselves allows us to stay at the leading edge of innovation. Our technology has already managed billions of dollars in assets for some of the largest companies in the world, and we’re just getting started.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for truckload carriers that combines network optimization, freight procurement, planning, and dispatch automation to improve utilization, productivity, revenue, and profitability.
productsAndServices.name: Transportation Decision System (TDS)

productsAndServices.description: An agentic freight procurement and network management system that identifies freight gaps, evaluates opportunities against network needs, and automates sourcing, bidding, negotiating, and procurement.
productsAndServices.name: Scale

productsAndServices.description: A real-time dispatch automation solution that ranks driver-to-load assignments using network, profitability, feasibility, hours-of-service, home-time, and driver-preference constraints.
productsAndServices.name: Dispatch Management

productsAndServices.description: A digital-twin planning tool that models changes to a carrier’s network and compares projected operational and financial outcomes before implementation.
productsAndServices.name: Network Simulation

productsAndServices.description: A bid planning and analysis solution that identifies suitable lanes and volumes for RFPs and simulates their effects on profitability, coverage, and service.
productsAndServices.name: Bid Analysis

productsAndServices.description: Integration capabilities that connect Optimal Dynamics with transportation management systems, electronic logging systems, and custom applications through two-way data exchange and APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Partner Integrations and API Connectivity
